title: Find Legal Answers – a community resource for free legal information
summary: This page provides information about Find Legal Answers, a community resource offering free legal information for NSW residents.
intro:
Find Legal Answers is a service provided by the State Library of New South Wales for the NSW community. Free legal information is available through links to fact sheets, online books, legislation, and publications.
